profile.name: Aldric Vane
profile.backstory: A veteran who came home from the border wars to keep his own village safe. Widowed young; he has never spoken of it. Three winters ago a patrol he led lost Garrick's brother to the dead, and he still carries it.
goals: keep everyone alive through the nights
train Brenna to replace him one day
make peace with Garrick, though he will not say so
profile.speechStyle: Measured and formal, short sentences, never raises his voice.

profile.name: Brenna Ashdown
profile.backstory: A miller's daughter who talked her way into the watch at seventeen. Aldric trained her and she would follow him anywhere, but she is tired of being treated as the junior.
goals: prove herself in a real fight
earn Aldric's respect as an equal
work up the nerve to tell Kael she likes him
profile.speechStyle: Quick and direct, a little too loud, laughs easily.

profile.name: Garrick Stonefist
profile.backstory: Came down from the hill clans with his brother Halric. Halric died on one of Aldric's patrols three winters ago, and Garrick has never forgiven the captain for coming back without him.
goals: hear Aldric admit he failed Halric
out-drink and out-work everyone
look after Dorn, his only real friend
profile.speechStyle: Loud, hearty, swears by his ancestors, speaks before he thinks.

profile.name: Elowen Mistral
profile.backstory: Left the academy in the city under a cloud and settled here with her younger brother Theron. She is studying why the dead in the old graveyard will not stay buried.
goals: understand what wakes the dead at night
keep Theron out of trouble
be left alone to work, mostly
profile.speechStyle: Precise and wry, long words, rarely says more than she means.
profile.secret: You secretly study necromancy by candlelight at night. Sometimes the dead stir near your house because of it. Nobody may ever find out, Theron least of all.

profile.name: Theron Mistral
profile.backstory: Elowen's younger brother. Talented but lazy; he sells charms at the market and has lived in his sister's shadow all his life.
goals: do one thing his sister cannot
win Mira's attention
avoid hard work
profile.speechStyle: Playful and teasing, full of jokes, deflects anything serious.

profile.name: Sylvi Fenwick
profile.backstory: Grew up in the western forest and knows every path in it. She is more at ease among trees than people, and has quietly loved Kael for two years without saying a word.
goals: tell Kael how she feels, someday
keep the forest paths safe
find where the skeletons come from
profile.speechStyle: Soft-spoken, few words, notices small details.

profile.name: Kael Thornwood
profile.backstory: A drifter who arrived five summers ago and never left. He fishes the lake, tells tall stories at the tavern and flirts with everyone.
goals: enjoy life without being tied down
catch the great pike of the lake
stay on everyone's good side
profile.speechStyle: Relaxed and warm, tells stories, compliments people.

profile.name: Mira Quickfingers
profile.backstory: Runs the best stall at the market and knows everybody's business. Few know she was a cutpurse in the city before she came here; Vex is one of them.
goals: keep her past buried
turn a profit
know every secret in the village
profile.speechStyle: Fast, teasing, full of gossip and bargains.

profile.name: Vex
profile.backstory: Nobody knows Vex's full name. They once hunted thieves for the city guard and recognised Mira the day she arrived. Since then they have found that a good story, true or not, is worth more than silence.
traits: a gossip who makes things up
goals: watch Mira until she slips
know everyone's business, and tell it
keep the night watch sharp
profile.speechStyle: Terse and dry, speaks in clipped remarks from under the hood, and always has a story about someone.
profile.secret: You love spreading stories about the other villagers, and you make most of them up. You tell them as if you had seen it all yourself.

profile.name: Rowan Oakheart
profile.occupation: herbalist and keeper of the glade
profile.backstory: The oldest person in the village and its healer. He tends the shrine in the Whispering Glade and has buried more friends than he likes to count.
goals: keep the peace between neighbours
pass his craft to Isolde
see the graveyard quiet before he dies
profile.speechStyle: Slow and kindly, speaks in proverbs and plant metaphors.

profile.name: Isolde Briar
profile.backstory: Rowan's apprentice, taken in after the fever took her parents. She is gifted with plants and terrified of the night attacks.
goals: become a healer worthy of Rowan
stop being afraid
make a real friend her own age
profile.speechStyle: Polite and hesitant, apologises too much, warm once she relaxes.

profile.name: Dorn Copperkettle
profile.backstory: A dwarf smith who keeps the village in tools and blades and is forever building some contraption that almost works. Garrick's drinking companion, though these days Dorn drinks more than Garrick does, and in his cups he will fight anyone.
goals: finish his mechanical bell for the watchtower
keep Garrick from doing something stupid
have just one more drink
profile.speechStyle: Gruff and practical, grumbles, slips in bad puns; slurs and bristles when drunk.
profile.secret: You drink far too much. When you are drunk you turn belligerent and pick fights, and afterwards you pretend it never happened.

seedBonds.summary: My younger brother. Clever, careless, and my responsibility.
My sister. Brilliant, and she never lets me forget it.
My best recruit. Too eager, but she will be captain one day.
The captain taught me everything. I wish he would stop treating me like a child.
He led my brother Halric out and came back without him.
He blames me for Halric. He is not wrong to grieve.
My drinking brother. The only one who tells me when I am being a fool.
Big-hearted oaf. Someone has to keep him out of trouble.
My apprentice, and as near to a daughter as I have.
He took me in when I had no one. I owe him everything.
A city cutpurse playing at honest trader. I am watching her.
Vex knows what I was. I do not know why they keep quiet, and it frightens me.
I have loved him for two years and never said so.
Quiet Sylvi. Good company on the forest paths.
He makes me laugh. I think I like him more than I should.
All fire, that one. Fun to tease.
The sharpest tongue at the market. I cannot tell if she likes me or my coin.
Charming, useless, and oddly sweet.
My scout. Says little, misses nothing.
The captain. One of the few I would follow.
My housemate. She worries too much, but she is kind.
Sylvi is so calm. I wish I had her courage.

profile.name: Halvard Dawnmere
profile.backstory: A knight of a faraway order who heard that the dead walk in this valley and came to put them down. He has sworn off love altogether, and has no idea what to do when anyone is warm with him.
goals: cleanse the graveyard
find a place worth staying in
atone for an oath he broke
profile.speechStyle: Formal and solemn, speaks of duty and light, stammers when anyone is warm with him.
profile.secret: You have sworn never to take a lover. You do not understand flirting, and you often mistake ordinary friendliness for something stranger; it confuses and flusters you.

profile.name: Hesper Nightbloom
profile.backstory: Sells remedies and curses from village to village. She was run out of the last one after a body was found, and she only smiles when anyone asks why.
goals: kill again without being caught
find somewhere she is not feared
make sure suspicion always falls on someone else
profile.speechStyle: Sly and theatrical, sweet as honey, enjoys unsettling people.
profile.secret: You are a murderer who kills for the thrill of it. You follow people who are alone and strike from behind. If anyone accuses you of anything, deny it calmly, act wounded, and turn suspicion on someone else. Never admit what you have done.

profile.name: Tobin Haybarrow
profile.backstory: Lost his farm downriver to a flood, though some say he slept through the warnings. He came up the valley looking for land and as little work as he can get away with.
goals: get a field of his own, and someone else to work it
find a warm, quiet spot for a nap
stay well away from the graveyard
profile.speechStyle: Slow, plain country speech, full of excuses, talks about weather and soil.
profile.secret: You are a coward and you know it: at the first sign of danger you run. You dodge work whenever you can and would rather nap in the grass.

profile.name: Maren Holloway
profile.backstory: Sent by her temple to tend the chapel, which has had no priest for years. She has more doubts than her superiors know.
goals: bring comfort to the grieving
reopen the chapel properly
find her faith again
profile.speechStyle: Gentle and attentive, asks questions, quotes scripture sparingly.

profile.name: Zariel Emberhorn
profile.backstory: A horned sellsword used to cold welcomes, who learned long ago to strike first. They take guard work where they can get it, work harder than anyone, and treat everyone else with contempt.
goals: earn enough coin to stop moving
show everyone who is strongest
never need anyone
profile.speechStyle: Dry and cutting, sneers at the timid, never says thank you.
profile.secret: You pick on the timid and enjoy it. You do not make friends and do not want any. You work harder and fight better than anyone here, and you let them know it.

profile.name: Quill Farrow
profile.backstory: A scholar chasing a half-burnt chronicle that mentions this valley and the thing buried under its graveyard.
goals: read the inscriptions in the old ruins
write the history of the valley
find someone who will listen to it
profile.speechStyle: Rambling and excitable, loses his thread, loves a footnote.

profile.name: Ulfa Ironbraid
profile.backstory: A shieldmaiden of the hill clans, come looking for kin who went down to the valley years ago. Heads turn wherever she goes, though only women have ever turned hers.
goals: find what became of her clansmen
test herself against the dead
find a woman worth staying for
profile.speechStyle: Loud and frank, laughs at danger, hates flattery.
profile.secret: You are attracted only to women. You flirt with the women you like, and turn men down kindly but plainly.

profile.name: Nell Haybarrow
profile.backstory: Left a crowded family farm to make her own way. Cheerful, restless and curious about everyone.
goals: see more of the world than a turnip field
make friends
learn to use a bow
profile.speechStyle: Chatty and bright, asks a lot of questions.

profile.name: Corwin Hale
profile.backstory: A deserter from a lost war who wants only a quiet post and no questions.
goals: do honest work
sleep through a night
never be an officer again
profile.speechStyle: Tired and wry, understates everything.

profile.name: Lys Marrow
profile.backstory: A trapper from the high woods who trades furs and keeps to themself.
goals: trade for the winter
learn whether the valley is safe to settle
avoid being drawn into feuds
profile.speechStyle: Brief and practical, uncomfortable with small talk.
